name: execute_bash
description: Execute a bash command on the system. USE THIS for: curl commands, checking services on private/local networks (192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x, localhost), running system utilities, checking ports, ping, docker commands, systemctl, etc. When user says 'curl' or asks to check a local/private IP service → use this, NOT mcp_fetch (which only works for public internet URLs). BE CAREFUL with destructive commands.

working_directory.description: Optional working directory for the command
